title: Careers in a Changing World
text:
Many people now expect to change careers several times in their lives. Fifty years ago, workers often remained with one company until retirement. Today, however, technology evolves quickly, and some jobs disappear while new ones appear. Consequently, employers look for candidates who are willing to keep learning.

Researchers suggest that future careers will depend heavily on flexibility, digital skills, and teamwork. Universities are therefore offering short courses that allow adults to update their knowledge without leaving their jobs. Some young professionals also work remotely for companies in other countries. Although this freedom can be exciting, it requires strong self-discipline and careful planning.

questions.text: According to the passage, what did workers often do fifty years ago?
options: They changed jobs every few years.
They worked from home most of the time.
They stayed with one company until retirement.
They studied at university for their whole lives.

questions.text: What are universities offering, according to the passage?
options: Short courses that let adults update their knowledge.

questions.text: Why do employers look for candidates who are willing to keep learning?
options: Because jobs change quickly and skills must be updated.
Because older workers are no longer needed.
Because universities require them to study.
Because retirement has become much shorter.

questions.text: What does the author suggest about working remotely for companies in other countries?
options: It is easy and requires no planning.
It is only suitable for retired people.
It offers freedom but demands self-discipline.
It is becoming less popular every year.

vocabulary.definition: people who are considered for a job or position
the ability to change or adapt easily to new situations
the time in life when a person stops working
the ability to control your own actions and keep working without being told

paragraph_translations: Багато людей сьогодні очікують, що за життя змінять роботу кілька разів. П'ятдесят років тому працівники часто залишалися в одній компанії до виходу на пенсію. Однак сьогодні технології швидко розвиваються, і деякі професії зникають, а з'являються нові. Тому роботодавці шукають кандидатів, які готові постійно навчатися.

Дослідники припускають, що майбутні кар'єри сильно залежатимуть від гнучкості, цифрових навичок і командної роботи. Тому університети пропонують короткі курси, які дозволяють дорослим оновлювати знання, не залишаючи роботу. Деякі молоді фахівці також працюють віддалено на компанії в інших країнах. Хоча ця свобода може бути захопливою, вона потребує великої самодисципліни та ретельного планування.
